description.zh: 需要解除关联的设备列表。
description.en: The list of devices to be dissociated.

description.zh: 需要解除项目中关联设备的DeviceName列表。
description.en: The DeviceName of the devices to be dissociated from the project.

description.zh: 解除项目中关联设备所隶属的产品ProductKey列表。
description.en: The ProductKey of the products to which the devices being dissociated from the project belong.

description.zh:
实例ID。

<props="china">您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。</props>

<props="china">
> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。</props>
description.en:
The instance ID.

<props="china">You can view the current instance ID on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID exists, you must specify it; otherwise, the invocation will fail.</props>

<props="china">
> If your public instance does not have an ID, see [How to Obtain an Instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

description.zh:
项目ID。
1. 您可登录[物联网应用开发控制台](https://studio.iot.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb)，在页面左上角选择对应实例后，在左侧导航栏单击项目管理。
2. 在普通项目列表中，找到目标项目，单击项目卡片，在地址栏中查看。
description.en:
The project ID.
1. Log on to the [IoT Application Development Console](https://studio.iot.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb). After selecting the corresponding instance in the upper-left corner of the page, click Project Management in the left-side navigation pane.
2. In the standard project list, locate the target project, click its project card, and then check the address bar of your browser.

descriptions.zh:
## 限制说明
- 单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
- 单次调用该接口最多可解除10个关联设备。
descriptions.en:
## Limits
- The maximum queries per second (QPS) for this API per Alibaba Cloud account is 5.
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
- You can dissociate up to 10 associated devices in a single API call.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot batch-unbind-project-devices --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --project-id a12000000 --devices ProductKey=a1BwAGV0000 DeviceName=Ee2000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot BatchUnbindProjectDevices --region cn-hangzhou --Devices.1.DeviceName Ee2000000 --Devices.1.ProductKey a1BwAGV0000 --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --ProjectId a12000000
